Are tuned cars a waste of time?!
Who’s ready for an almighty Honda drag race!
We’ve got our hands on a standard Honda Civic Type R, and we’re about to put it up against a whole load of tuned Civic Type Rs to see if the various tunes and modifications have been worth it.
The Honda Civic Type R is powered by a 2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder that produces 329hp and 420Nm. It sends that power to the front wheels via a 6-speed manual and weighs in at 1,429. The total cost is £46,995.
Now let’s take a look at the contenders:
Tuned FL5: 420hp, 570Nm, 1,430kg, £67,000
